summary_1line: Bhima returns empowered after the Nagas save him; Duryodhana’s plots continue; the princes begin training under Kripa, whose strange birth from Saradwat is introduced.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima rises from the waters of the netherworld adorned in white garlands as serpent Nagas surround and bless him.
Bhima runs into Kunti’s arms while his brothers crowd around, all rejoicing at his miraculous return.
In a forest hermitage, the ascetic Saradwat beholds a beautiful celestial damsel while his bow and arrows slip from his trembling hands.
